title: 111 and 222 synchronicities during the reunion trip

tellings.quote: He landed at 111. And Omar, who's coming from Yes Theory, he is taking off at 111.

plain: During a 2026 trip in Texas that reunited Air Force veterans who say they were abducted by aliens about fifty years earlier, Michels kept noticing the numbers 111 and 222 showing up on the clock. He says it himself on the show: one person "landed at 111", and a man named Omar, travelling in from a group called Yes Theory, was "taking off at 111." Michels offers these as meaningful coincidences, a hint that something beyond chance was hanging over the reunion.
